decision_notes: Phase A: workspace safety check; HEAD=6f5566a; only untracked runtime files; no dirty blocker.
Phase B: 8 upstream spec review artifact categories read; all gates pass; previous_status=PASS; can_run_probe_now=false.
Phase C: scripts/lp_base_10u_probe_executor_v1.py built (700+ lines); hard-coded candidate freeze; supports 4 modes; rejects --mode execute.
Phase D: preflight mode runs eth_chainId, eth_getBalance, ERC20 balanceOf, allowance, pool.slot0, pool.liquidity, QuoterV2 (best-effort), eth_estimateGas; no signing/sending/approve/mint.
Phase E: print-unsigned mode emits structured JSON with unsigned_only / no_signature / no_send / execution_not_authorized all true.
Phase F: validate-approval mode parses regex; whole-word dangerous-word check; cross-checks wallet/pool/notional/hold against frozen; success does NOT authorize execution (executes_now=false).
Phase G: telemetry writer skeleton writes 5 schema files to local reports dir only; no production table writes.
Phase H: stop condition engine evaluates 13 stops; any abort_before_entry stop sets preflight_status=FAIL; no auto-retry.
Phase I: 7 execution stubs (approve_exact_usdc, approve_exact_weth, mint_position, monitor_position, decrease_liquidity, collect_fees, revoke_allowance); each raises ExecutionDisabledInBuildStage.
Phase J: 11-case self-check ran; all functional; deviation applied (substring -> whole-word regex) for DANGEROUS_WORD_PATTERNS.
Phase K: this FINAL_VERDICT + ONEPAGE + ARTIFACT_INDEX.
secondary_observations: DANGEROUS_WORD_PATTERNS initial substring match false-positived on the canonical phrase; fixed by switching to whole-word regex (re.search). This is a 'deviation' that the self-check documents.

The env-var safety check is broad enough to refuse ANTHROPIC_API_KEY; narrowed to only block crypto / wallet / secret-store env names (private_key, mnemonic, keystore, wallet_key, signer_key, *_database_url, *_postgres_dsn, etc.) so legitimate AI tooling in the harness is not blocked.
executor_will_run_this_round = false even though self_check_ran = true; self_check only invokes read-only modes.

The build-stage artifact (this script) does NOT have a wallet client, signer, or any private-key loader. Any future executor that uses this build as a starting point must re-introduce those in a separate review stage.
next_stage_must_not: execute the probe in the next review stage
construct a wallet client or signer in the next review stage
treat this build as a finished execution tool — it is a skeleton only
